categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan PSBT signing logic in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where FillPSBT failed to provide keys for an owned input when a PSBT contained conflicting witness and non-witness UTXOs. Aligns FillPSBT's UTXO resolution with SignPSBTInput via PSBTInput::GetUTXO, resolving confusing signing failures in this edge case without affecting general fund safety.
